thread:
ella: Heads-up — Meridian Labs wants a joint co-sell POC next week. Key asks: 10-day shared sandbox, tenant-perms for partner engineers, telemetry stream to their Splunk, and a safe pricing stub for channel. Also asked if we can support partner-managed KMS for keys.
pete: Partner-managed HSM requires Redwood Private. For hosted we can offer BYOK with cross-account KMS; partner-managed key import into cloud KMS is fine.
nora: Traffic profile: expected steady 25 rps, spikes to 250 rps for 10m. Recommend a 4-node vGPU staging pool with autoscale to 8 and aggressive prefix caching enabled.
infra-bot: Provisioning checklist created: TASK-7124. Needs partner org name, billing contact, and peering CIDR. Inbound 443; outbound to partner analytics (ports 443, 9200).
sec: Security: we'll send SOC2 + network diagram. Flag: data residency — they want EU-only processing for some tenants. We can pin tenant to eu-west-1. Also requires masking for PII fields; we'll enable request-filter.
ella: Good. Billing: can we offer a trial credit and sample co-sell pricing for their channel partner? They prefer monthly reservation as a follow-on.
billing-bot: Drafting a stub: $2,500 trial credit for POC; tentative reserved baseline 2 vGPUs/mo with 20% partner discount first 3 months. Need token/hr estimate.
pete: Token est: avg 2k tokens/session * concurrency 30 peak ~60k tokens/hr baseline, up to 600k tokens/hr during spikes. I'll post a detailed calc in the sheet.
ella: Can someone paste a tiny curl for them to smoke test routing and tenant keys? Keep it minimal.
infra-bot: Use this (replace <TOKEN>):
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rw-small","input":"ping","max_tokens":3}'
```
Expected: {"status":"ok","output":"pong"}
ella: I'll set a runbook for Tue 10am PT covering tenant provisioning, peering, telemetry handoff, and pricing sign-off. Action items: pete 1 run detailed cost calc + populate sheet (TASK-7125), sec 1 send SOC2 and residency text, billing-bot 1 attach draft quote. Anything else?
nora: Add throttling note: set POC burst limit to 300 req/min to protect shared pool.
ella: Noted. I'll consolidate and send partner invite. :white_check_mark:
